description: Create a DNS record on a domain with ZapX nameservers (or an active Cloudflare protection). name is relative to the domain ('@' = the domain itself). MX needs priority, SRV needs priority, weight and port. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

content.description: Record value (IP address, hostname, TXT text, ...).

name.description: Record name relative to the domain: '@' (default) for the domain itself, 'www', '_acme-challenge', ...

name: create_domain_dns_record
title: Create Domain DNS Record
